versions.content: Use of Conf iguration pointers to Post - build configuration data structure is restricted The Post - build configuration data structure of each BSW module shall be pointed to by Configuration pointers . Only EcuM contains Configuration pointers to the Post - build configura tion data structure of post - build configurable modules which need to be initialized before the initialization of BswM . The rest of the BSW modules are initialized via configuration pointers by BswM .
